name: vnets
description: Query VNets of PVE remotes with optional filtering options

params.name: pending
params.description: Include a list of attributes whose changes are currently pending.

params.name: remotes
params.description: Only return controllers from the specified remotes.

params.name: running
params.description: If true shows the running configuration, otherwise the pending configuration.

returns.description: Get a list of controllers fitting the filtering criteria.

items.description: SDN controller with additional information about which remote it belongs to

isolate-ports.description:
If true, sets the isolated property for all interfaces on the bridge of
this VNet.

pending.description: Changes that have not yet been applied to the running configuration.

isolate-ports.description:
If true, sets the isolated property for all interfaces on the bridge of
this VNet.

tag.description:
VLAN Tag (for VLAN or QinQ zones) or VXLAN VNI (for VXLAN or EVPN
zones).

vlanaware.description: Allow VLANs to pass through this VNet.

zone.description: Name of the zone this VNet belongs to.

state.description: The state of an SDN object.

tag.description:
VLAN Tag (for VLAN or QinQ zones) or VXLAN VNI (for VXLAN or EVPN
zones).

vlanaware.description: Allow VLANs to pass through this VNet.

zone.description: Name of the zone this VNet belongs to.

permissions.description:
The user needs to have at least the `Resource.Audit` privilege under `/resource`.
        Only vnets from remotes for which the user has `Resource.Audit` on `/resource/{remote_name}`
        will be included in the returned list.
